nodes.name: Insert proposal + approval outbox row (once per broker, cycle, op)

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  INSERT INTO ops.proposals (source, faculty, title, metric, number_at_decision, cost_zar, owner_agent, status, mechanism, evidence)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7, 'proposed', $8, $9
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.notifications x WHERE x.dedupe_key = $10)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO ops.notifications (kind, recipient, channel, source, status, ref_table, ref_id, dedupe_key, proposal_id, what, payload)
SELECT 'approval', 'jonathan', 'console', 'ads_budget', 'queued', 'proposals', p.id::text, $10, p.id, $3, $11::jsonb
  FROM p
RETURNING proposal_id::text AS proposal_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const p = $json.proposal; const n = $json.notification; return [ p.source, p.faculty, p.title, p.metric, p.number_at_decision, p.cost_zar, p.owner_agent, p.mechanism, p.evidence, n.dedupe_key, JSON.stringify(n.payload) ]; })() }}

parameters.content:
## smc-ads-budget: propose only (NH-57 default a)
Input `{ op: raise|lower, broker_id, cycle_id, amount_zar, reason }` (also `{ action, media_share_zar }`). Every change becomes an `ops.proposals` row (faculty media, source `ads_budget`; platform-architect adds the value to the check, I-48i) plus one `ops.notifications` approval row (channel console, source ads_budget, never `console`, so W32 does not read it as a decision). The Meta budget write path is never called here.

**Alternative (b), not built:** a decrease-only system path in `ads/meta-ads.js` (ads-api-engineer) so `lower` applies unattended at cycle end without a confirmToken, while `raise` keeps the confirm gate. Money decision: Jonathan picks (a) or (b).
